input.subject: Brook
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Soul Solid fencing, music including sleep-inducing Nemuriuta Flanc, underworld chill and soul projection through Wano. Revive-Revive fruit is a once-used resurrection, not repeat resurrection skill. Music control has explicit eligibility and boss limits. Soul projection reconnaissance requires honest limitation if unsupported. Chill is soul-linked, not a generic frost mage. Preserve gentleman musician/skeleton traits. Preserve Nemuriuta Flanc as a musical sleep effect, with zero enemy damage at EVERY legal build where it is selectable. The supplied source describes falling asleep from a tune played with the sword as bow, not damaging sound. Since flatDamage affects zero-damage Techniques, do not author any flatDamage purchases; use meaningful damage multipliers, timing, reach, sourced control or hearing improvements instead. Keep sword attacks damaging. Distinguish weaker hearing conditions from reliable game detection, and soul projection from hearing. Soul projection appearance/scouting must be described precisely; use supported mechanics only if they preserve its actual role, otherwise disclose the missing free-scour/scouting runtime without inventing a ghost damage spell. Keep the three paths distinct: fencing output, musical control and soul-linked chill/hearing. A higher contextual Technique replaces the previous one; preserve the musical path's usefulness despite that limitation. All durations/resources are bounded game choices for supported techniques. Root description below 1900 characters; put detailed caveats into relevant path descriptions.

knowledge.subject: Brook
gaps: The supplied pages establish Brook's abilities and Wano continuity but do not provide the requested game's current Manga Mayhem contract, schema for resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, or shared technique lifecycle.

No supplied source establishes exact numerical damage, range, attack speed, cooldowns, prices, unlock schedules, legal maximum interactions, or the precise three-path structure. Any such values would be game adaptations and must be disclosed as tuning rather than canon.
No supplied source establishes a playable stationary tower-encounter implementation, caller-supplied enemy motion, ally-injury handling, or the exact meaning of the legal maximum 5-2-0.

Nemuriuta Flanc is supported as a sleep-inducing technique, but the supplied pages do not define eligibility rules, duration, resistance rules, boss limits, or how music control should operate against bosses.

Brook's soul projection is supported for movement through walls and inaccessible areas, but the supplied pages do not support unrestricted reconnaissance, map-wide detection, target acquisition, or interaction with objects. A playable implementation needs an explicit limitation.

The supplied pages support soul-linked Underworld chill and freezing through Soul Solid, but do not support treating Brook as a generic frost mage or define a complete status model for freezing, slowing, or resistance.

The supplied pages establish the Revive-Revive Fruit resurrection origin, but do not support repeat resurrection as an executable skill. A playable unit should preserve the once-used resurrection as lore or an explicitly limited mechanic, not a repeatable revive.
The supplied sources do not establish unsupported game traits such as tower HP, shields, taunt, free unit movement, air-only target classes, or other requested mechanics not represented in the pages.

The supplied pages establish Brook's gentleman musician and skeleton traits, but do not specify runtime representations for humor, gentlemanly conduct, bone storage, pain, fear, world-star status, or resistance to every disease. These should be preserved as omissions or bounded adaptations rather than invented stat bonuses.
The abilities page contains material beyond the specified cutoff, including references from later chapters. Those post-Wano facts were not used as selected continuity evidence.

findings.message: Pulse and emission cycles count successful primary attack cycles required for one trigger, not waves per trigger. A cycle counts once when at least one primary hit applies positive damage, regardless of collateral targets. Pulses apply stun without damage; their event amount counts affected targets. Emissions apply their declared damage. Pulse intervals can further limit trigger frequency.

unassessed: Source fidelity requires evidence and independent review.

gaps: Soul projection is a requested defining ability but remains unimplemented. Its limitations and the missing free-scouring/scouting runtime are explicitly disclosed, consistent with the user's permission to omit it rather than invent a ghost attack.

Pulse and purchased contact-stun immunity depend on caller-supplied weakWilled and stunnable eligibility. These shared modifiers do not independently enforce all hearing, boss and immunity tags configured on Nemuriuta Flanc's onHit sleep status.
Concealed detection is deliberately more reliable and less conditional than the sourced movement-sound feat; no executable test for audible movement is supplied.

Stamina capacity, recovery, costs, cooldowns, unlock tiers and control bounds are disclosed host scheduling and tuning. This review does not establish canonical exhaustion, performance regeneration rates or measured balance.

The zero-damage conclusion concerns this candidate's purchases and effects. It does not establish immunity to externally supplied damage-taken additions or other encounter mechanics outside the authored build.

Post-Wano material present in the evidence was excluded from the ability assessment. The report is a bounded review of the supplied passages, not fresh independent retrieval or a guarantee of complete canon coverage.
